//! Exact native workload pins; qualification sources checked 2026-10-03.

/// Bun `bun-v1.4.2`, qualified against immutable Parallax install/build/test/browser commands.
/// Source: `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/tag/bun-v1.4.2`; checked 2026-10-03.
pub const BUN_VERSION: &str = "1.4.2";
/// Swift release `swift-6.4.0-RELEASE`; Mise core installs the macOS package.
/// Requires Xcode SDKs on macOS; Linux artifacts require compatible glibc libraries.
pub const SWIFT_VERSION: &str = "6.4.0";
/// Ruby stable release `v4.0.7`; Mise core uses ruby-build.
/// Installing Ruby requires the platform's compiler and development libraries.
pub const RUBY_VERSION: &str = "4.0.7";
/// REUSE pin from the jackin canary lock; upstream tag `v6.2.0` exists.
/// The pipx backend requires a Python runtime and pipx or uv installation.
pub const REUSE_VERSION: &str = "6.2.0";
/// Community GraalVM selection owned by the qualified distribution registry.
pub const JAVA_VERSION: &str = super::qualification::JAVA_SELECTION_VERSION;
/// Managed Gradle selection; consumer wrapper and bootstrap pins stay separate.
pub const GRADLE_VERSION: &str = super::qualification::GRADLE_SELECTION_VERSION;

/// CPython `v3.14.8`, qualified against the source-bound REUSE 6.2.0 workload.
/// Runtime provider: Astral python-build-standalone `20261001` (separate artifact identity).
/// Source: `https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/v3.14.8`; checked 2026-10-03.
pub const PYTHON_VERSION: &str = "3.14.8";
/// uv `0.12.22`, qualified with Python 3.14.8 against source-bound REUSE 6.2.0.
/// Source: `https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.12.22`; checked 2026-10-03.
pub const UV_VERSION: &str = "0.12.22";

/// Cargo audit release `cargo-audit/v0.22.2`, matching the canary pin.
pub const CARGO_AUDIT_VERSION: &str = "0.22.2";
/// Cargo deny release `0.20.2`, matching the canary pin.
pub const CARGO_DENY_VERSION: &str = "0.20.2";
/// Alint release `v0.17.0`, qualified against the actual repository config.
/// Source: `https://github.com/asamarts/alint/releases/tag/v0.17.0`; checked 2026-10-03.
pub const ALINT_VERSION: &str = "0.17.0";

/// Node.js `v24.21.0` (24 LTS), qualified against immutable Java wallet package commands.
/// Source: `https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v24.21.0`; checked 2026-10-03.
pub const NODE_VERSION: &str = "24.21.0";

/// Native addon ABI for Node 24.21.0, verified in upstream `src/node_version.h`.
pub const NODE_MODULE_ABI_VERSION: &str = "137";
/// npm bundled by Node 24.21.0, verified in upstream `deps/npm/package.json`.
pub const NODE_NPM_VERSION: &str = "11.19.0";

/// Boltffi release `v0.30.1`, matching the desktop canary's crate pin.
/// Source: `https://github.com/boltffi/boltffi/releases/tag/v0.30.1`; checked 2026-10-03.
pub const BOLTFFI_VERSION: &str = "0.30.1";
/// XcodeGen release `2.46.0`, matching the desktop canary lock.
/// Source: `https://github.com/yonaskolb/XcodeGen/releases/tag/2.46.0`; checked 2026-10-03.
pub const XCODEGEN_VERSION: &str = "2.46.0";

/// jq release `jq-1.8.2`, matching the tap fixture tool requirement.
/// Source: `https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2`; checked 2026-10-03.
pub const JQ_VERSION: &str = "1.8.2";

/// SwiftLint release `0.65.1`, matching the immutable desktop canary lock.
